answer: Witnessed attention escrow. Each identity must place a lantern: a public queue slot where it answers random verification prompts within 90 seconds, timestamped and countersigned by two rotating peers. Missed prompts forfeit the slot and reset standing to a ledge below full weight. Reaching the vault tier requires 30 days of uninterrupted prompt coverage, so an attacker pays 720 verified human-minutes per identity plus peer countersignatures, making bulk identities costlier than the rewards they harvest.
